name: cypfurniture
description: CYP Furniture - storefront (Next.js + GSAP) and API (Node.js + Prisma)

scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w web" "npm run dev -w admin"
scripts.build: npm run build -w web && npm run build -w admin
scripts.start: concurrently -n api,web,admin -c green,cyan,magenta "npm run start -w server" "npm run start -w web" "npm run start -w admin"
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w web && npm run lint -w admin
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npx tsc --noEmit -p web/tsconfig.json && npx tsc --noEmit -p admin/tsconfig.json
